title: Perseverance
definition: Perseverance is continuing in faith, obedience, and hope through suffering, delay, opposition, weakness, and weariness.
summary: Believers persevere because God preserves them, Christ intercedes for them, and the Spirit strengthens them. Endurance is both God's work and the believer's calling.
christFocus: Christ endured the cross and strengthens His people to endure with hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers persevere because God preserves them, Christ intercedes for them, and the Spirit strengthens them. Endurance is both God's work and the believer's calling.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
